note_manual: Printed inconsistencies visible in the crops: (1) PSD 'polydispersity of δ = 0.6r̄' (p.542) vs 'polydispersity of 0.4' (p.545), both citing Chung [6]; (2) Φ_RCP = 0.637 + 0.0658δ + 0.0857Sδ² gives 0.681/0.689/0.689/0.687/0.687 with the printed inputs, the printed 0.678/0.686/0.686/0.684/0.684 are reproduced with a constant 0.634; (3) Parteli Φ = 0.64 − 0.99/(2r̄)^0.676 with r̄ = 6 μm gives 0.455, not the printed 0.38; (4) '0 bar … within 0.06–0.11' but 92 % wt differs by 0.12 (Table 3); (5) 'exceed 6 after 2000 bar' holds for 4 of 8 DEM runs (Table 4) and the f′ 92 % ratio 4.165 lies outside the tomography range 0.953–3.378 claimed 'well within'; (6) Eqs. (3)–(4) print N^(4)_ij for N^(4)_ijkl; Appendix B second-rank λ prints D_ij D_kl; (7) Table 3 headers say '% vol.' but values are fractions; (8) reference list: [11] J. Manuf. Sci. Eng. 136 (1966), [24] issue (4) vs URL '55.3.245', [26] and [31] without pages / year, [37] 'granlar'.
key_note: manual keys: ga = graphical abstract; f<N><panel> = panel crop of Fig. N (panel_of; f6a–f6f2 = rows a–f′ of Fig. 6 with the header strip stacked; f7a/f7b = X-Z / X-Y rows with header); e<NN> = equation crop (kind 'equation'), ein_* = inline formula crop; x<page><letter> = evidence paragraph (kind 'text'; entries with 'parts' stack several column / page parts of one passage).  File names and 'page' use PDF pages (journal page = PDF page + 539).
